purpose: Teach: ハイブリッド/ハンセン病/要塞/点字/沸騰/磁石/ワイヤー/リフト

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハイブリッド車を選ばれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father chose a hybrid car.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful observation shared with her son. Gentle cadence, as if noticing something small about his father that matters. Quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ハンセン病史のお話、図書館で読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a book about Hansen's disease history at the library.
lines.style: Earnest and clear, eager to share something he learned. Direct eye contact. Small boy genuinely interested in what he's discovered. No performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと要塞のお城に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, shall we go to that fortress castle with your father sometime?
lines.style: Warm invitation delivered as gentle suggestion, not instruction. Slight rise at the end like she's opening a door for him. Tender, inclusive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、点字の絵本もらったよ
lines.en: Mom, I got a braille picture book.
lines.style: Bright, direct announcement of something he's proud of. Quick pace, genuine excitement in his small voice. Unselfconscious joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お湯が沸騰したらお父さんを呼んでね
lines.en: Sho, when the water boils, call your father, will you?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact practical instruction delivered warmly. Quick, clear, the rhythm of an everyday task. No fussiness—just mother-logic.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、磁石で釘集めて楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mom, I had fun collecting nails with a magnet.
lines.style: Bright recounting of something simple that delighted him. Soft smile in his voice. The natural rhythm of a child remembering a small joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古いワイヤーを処分されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was throwing out some old wire.
lines.style: Casual observation, slightly musing. The kind of small domestic fact a mother notices and shares. Reflective but not weighted.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスキー場のリフトに乗りたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to ride the ski lift with Dad.
lines.style: Hopeful, wistful want in his voice. Soft but clear—not demanding, just expressing something he'd like. The closeness of someone comfortable asking.
